title: Quenched Tunisian Nutella Wrap
description: A malty, silky Tunisian-inspired wrap that blends Nutella with tahini, honey, and harissa. The wrap is deep-fried in a lotus leaf for a quick, dash-friendly snack.
instructions: Soak lotus leaf in warm water for 2 minutes to soften.
In a small bowl whisk Nutella, honey, tahini, almond butter, milk, and harissa paste until smooth.
Pat the softened lotus leaf dry and lay on a clean cloth.
Spread 2 tsp of the Nutella mixture evenly over the leaf, leaving a small border.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the spread.
Fold the leaf into a wrap by bringing the sides together and rolling tightly.
Heat olive oil in a deep pan to 180°C (350°F).
Carefully place the wrapped lotus leaf into the hot oil, frying for 2-3 minutes until golden and crisp.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain excess oil on paper towels.
Let cool for 1 minute, then slice into bite-sized pieces for serving.
